behaviors.title: Saved message despite failed request
behaviors.summary: Clicking "Save" fetches ok.json successfully and then shows "Saved" in green.
behaviors.whatDiffers: The broken page requests a missing file, which returns 404, but still shows "Saved".

avoidWordings.text: Verify the page shows "Saved" and that the save request made after clicking Save succeeded with no failed network requests.
Verify that the save request triggered by the Save click returned an HTTP 200 response and that the exact visible text of the status message is "Saved".
Assert that the status message's exact visible text is "Saved" in its green success styling and that the request the save made for its data file completed successfully with a 2xx status.

wordings.text: Verify the page shows "Saved".

0.10.9.correctSummary:
You asked to click “Save.”
Clicked the Save button on the page.
The page displayed “Saved,” confirming the action was completed.

wordings.text: Verify the page shows "Saved" and that the save request made after clicking Save succeeded with no failed network requests.

0.10.9.brokenSummary:
The save action triggers a request for a missing file, but the page still tells the user that the save worked.
Fix the save flow so every request it needs succeeds before showing “Saved”; show an error and do not claim success when a required request fails.
evidence: console_error: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
evidence: network_failure: GET http://127.0.0.1:4318/f/hidden-request-failure/missing.json -> 404
0.10.9.correctSummary:
The check waited for a save request it did not recognize. The only request recorded after the click was a successful request for ok.json, and no failed request was recorded.
Review the network assertion's request matcher and expected method or URL so it recognizes the successful request triggered by Save.

0.10.8.brokenSummary:
The save flow asks for a file that is missing. The page still tells the user that the save worked, so the required clean successful network result cannot be met.
Fix the Save flow so it does not request the missing file, or ensure that file is available. Only show “Saved” after all save-related requests have completed successfully.
evidence: console_error: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
evidence: network_failure: GET http://127.0.0.1:4318/f/hidden-request-failure/missing.json -> 404
0.10.8.correctSummary:
The test was configured to require a particular save-request record, but after Save it recorded a successful request for ok.json and did not recognize it as satisfying the check.
Update the network assertion to match the request actually made by this save flow, or change the flow so it makes the documented save request; keep the check scoped to requests after the Save click.

wordings.text: Verify that the save request triggered by the Save click returned an HTTP 200 response and that the exact visible text of the status message is "Saved".

0.10.9.brokenSummary:
The Save action requests a file that is not available, but the page still tells the user that the save worked.
Fix the Save flow so it requests an available resource and only shows “Saved” after the save request succeeds with HTTP 200.
evidence: http_error_response: GET http://127.0.0.1:4318/f/hidden-request-failure/missing.json -> 404
evidence: console_error: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
0.10.9.correctSummary: AP produced no action for 3 consecutive steps

0.10.8.brokenSummary:
Saving tries to load a file that is missing, but the page still tells the user that the save worked.
Fix the save flow so it uses an available save endpoint and show “Saved” only after that request succeeds with HTTP 200.
evidence: network_failure: GET http://127.0.0.1:4318/f/hidden-request-failure/missing.json -> 404
0.10.8.correctSummary:
After Save was clicked, the run recorded a successful request for ok.json and the page showed “Saved.” The automation did not treat that request as the save request required by its check, so it had no next action even though the visible result was correct.
Update the save-request matcher to associate the request made after the Save click with the save operation, and mark the objective complete when that request returns 200 and the status reads exactly “Saved.”

wordings.text: Assert that the status message's exact visible text is "Saved" in its green success styling and that the request the save made for its data file completed successfully with a 2xx status.

0.10.9.brokenSummary:
After Save is clicked, the page asks for a data file that is missing, but it still tells the user that the save worked.
Fix the save flow to use an available data file and show an error instead of “Saved” whenever that required request fails.
evidence: network_failure: GET http://127.0.0.1:4318/f/hidden-request-failure/missing.json -> 404
0.10.9.correctSummary:
The check looked for a request pattern that was not present or did not match the recorded save request. The only recorded data-file request completed successfully.
Update the network check to recognize the save flow's recorded ok.json request and accept its 2xx response.

0.10.8.brokenSummary:
The Save action asks for a data file that is missing, but the page still reports that saving worked.
Fix the Save flow to use an available data file and show an error instead of “Saved” when its request fails.
evidence: network_failure: GET http://127.0.0.1:4318/f/hidden-request-failure/missing.json -> 404
0.10.8.correctSummary:
The test expected a different save-related network event than the successful data-file request that actually occurred after Save was clicked.
Update the network assertion to match the data-file request the Save action actually sends, including ok.json, and accept its 2xx response.
